subject: Call finalizerProc when free the aeTimeEvent in ae (#13101)
reason: The change makes aeDeleteEventLoop call each pending time event's finalizerProc before freeing it (src/ae.c:152-153). No code in the tree registers a finalizer: every aeCreateTimeEvent call site (serverCron in server.c:2743, evictionTimeProc in evict.c:475, module timers in module.c:9244, showThroughput in redis-benchmark.c:1012/1736) passes NULL, so the new branch is never taken.
